headline: Next Met Gala Show Will Honor John Galliano, Celebrated Designer Infamous for Antisemitic Rant
context: As famous for his antisemitic rant in 2011 as he is for his fashion, Galliano would be one of only three living designers ever to receive the honor.

sources.name: The New York Times
